x: Tony Fairclough had different ideas on the subject and caring little for the reputation of Frank Salvat,produced the best ever run by a Belgrave Harrier on this leg;and in knocking four seconds from Dave Baulch's club record became the first Belgravian to beat twenty minutes.
Names to disappear are:- Dave Baulch, Charlie Smart, Barry Sawyer, John Dear, Mal Robinson, Pete Bagnall, John Bromley, Ray Tooby, Archie Bedford and Kelly Diprose.
